# Bool

> Bool is a Portuguese software consultancy founded in 2013 and part of the Code for All_ Group. It delivers AI-Augmented Development: enterprise software, AI agents and AI applications built by senior teams with governance by design. Bool is an OutSystems Gold Partner (since 2019), a Mendix Official Partner and part of the Claude Partner Network.

Key facts:

- Founded in 2013, part of the Code for All_ Group
- 150+ team members, 300+ projects delivered, 750+ certifications
- Offices in Lisbon, Porto, Azores and Castelo Branco (Portugal); clients across Europe
- Head office: R. do Centro Cultural 27A, 1700-106 Lisboa, Portugal
- Contact: info@bool.pt

## Services

- [Services](https://bool.pt/services/): overview of what Bool delivers, how it works and the platforms it uses
- [AI Engineering](https://bool.pt/ai-engineering/): design, build and governance of AI agents and AI applications in production
- [OutSystems](https://bool.pt/outsystems/): AI-Augmented Development on OutSystems and ODC, modernization, certified teams and training
- [Mendix](https://bool.pt/mendix/): AI-Augmented Development on Mendix, expert services, training and enterprise delivery
